title: Extension Conversion
meta: Turn installs into active users with clearer onboarding, upgrade prompts and calls to action. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Extension conversion, from install to active user
overview: Many people install an extension and never open it again. We look at the first minute your users spend with yours and fix what is unclear. We write and build a short welcome flow, tidy the call to action in the popup and add a fair, honest upgrade prompt if you charge. We also set up simple event counts so you can see where people stop. Everything follows store rules on prompts.

pkgs.blurb: A clear first-run welcome and a sharper main call to action.
A guided onboarding flow plus an upgrade prompt that stays polite.
An onboarding and upgrade system with two variants you can compare.
list: Rate-us prompt at a good moment

faq: Will this raise my installs or revenue?
We cannot promise numbers. We make the first minute clearer and give you counts that show where people stop, so each next change is based on evidence rather than guesses.
Are upgrade prompts allowed by the store?
Yes, when they are honest and do not mislead or block core use. We follow Chrome Web Store rules on payments and user data and avoid pushy or deceptive patterns.
How do you count events without invading privacy?
We count simple actions such as finishing step two, with no personal details or page content. We write a matching privacy note so your store form stays accurate.
Do I need payments set up already?
Only if you want an upgrade prompt that links to a checkout. If you have no payment system yet, we build the prompt to point at your page or ask about our integration service.
